R1.name: Cross-sectional meme momentum
R1.line: Hold the 1-3 liquid memes with the strongest risk-adjusted recent return, swap out any that drop out of the top, and sit in cash when BTC is below its 50-day average or no meme has positive momentum.
gates_failed: not robust to nearby parameters (25% of neighbours positive)

R2.name: Edge-monitor rotation (owner's idea)
R2.line: Run one breakout setup on every liquid meme but only trade a coin while its own last N closed paper trades are net profitable, preferring the most hyped admitted coin.
gates_failed: not positive at double costs without the best coin (PENGUUSDT)

R3.name: Long strong / short faded
R3.line: Hold the single strongest meme (when BTC is above its 50-day average) and short up to two memes whose hype burst has died (M11).

R4.name: Volatility-targeted best of R1-R3
R4.line: Trade exactly like the best of R1-R3, but cut each position so its daily volatility is at most v of equity (never above the 1%-risk size).

R5.name: Short the faders
R5.line: Memes as a group bleed value, so short the 1-3 liquid memes with the weakest risk-adjusted recent return and swap them out when they stop being the weakest.
